scope_note: MAPPPD count outcomes have already been opened for the frozen A/H/A:H analyses, but the prespecified terrain R coefficient has not been fitted or inspected. This gate is therefore pre-R-outcome computational validation, not a claim that the whole study remains outcome-blind.

terrain_source.transform: log1p then z-standardize within each species analysis frame
terrain_source.spatial_centering: center the standardized trait within the frozen V3 trait_block before loading estimation

estimator.implementation_mapping: Place standardized terrain R in the existing A slot, set H=0 and A:H=0, and interpret fitted gamma_A as gamma_R. This yields exactly one active site-trait column while preserving the V3 forcing, block-intercept, residual-loading and observation-calibration machinery.

paper_gate: All four checks must pass independently in ADPE, CHPE and GEPE before the real terrain R_main fit is executed.

real_fit_after_pass.inference_boundary: Do not invent a new confirmatory p-value unless a terrain-specific permutation rule is already frozen elsewhere. If no such rule exists, retain R_main as a prespecified point-estimate analysis and label any newly designed permutation inference post-outcome.

interpretation_boundaries: Passing recovery establishes estimator identifiability for R under the frozen simulation stress test; it does not establish an ecological terrain effect.
Do not inspect real gamma_R values before the recovery gate is frozen and executed.
Do not modify the 2 km relief trait, transformation, spatial blocks, species cohort or estimator based on the real R result.
Any species life-history ordering of gamma_R that was not frozen before counts were opened is exploratory interpretation.
